## **Radiation Shielding Products for Nuclear Medicine, Nuclear Energy, and NDT**
* ### [**Lead Lined Cabinets**][107]
  
  Custom and standard lead lined cabinets designed for secure storage and shielding in nuclear
  medicine and nuclear energy environments.
  
  [Explore Lead Lined Cabinets][108]
* ### [**L-Block Shields**][109]
  
  99.9% pure lead brick caves engineered for reliable lateral shielding in hot labs and nuclear
  medicine applications, with configurations that simplify installation.
  
  [Explore L-Bricks][110]
* ### [**Rolling Barriers**][111]
  
  Standard and custom mobile radiation barriers built with lead glass or lead acrylic viewing panels
  for dependable protection, clear visibility, and flexible use in medical and controlled
  environments.
  
  [Explore Our Rolling Barriers][112]
* ### [**Nuclear Energy Lead Pours**][113]
  
  ISO 9001:2015 and N299.3-16 certified nuclear lead pours backed by documented, industry-approved
  procedures.
  
  [Explore Nuclear Leaad Pours][114]
* ### [**Lead Bricks**][115]
  
  A full range of straight & interlocking lead bricks designed for flexible shielding configurations
  across nuclear, medical, and industrial environments.
  
  [Explore Lead Bricks][116]
* ### [**Honeycomb Wave Guides**][117]
  
  Hex cell waveguide air vents engineered to treat HVAC penetrations in RF shielded enclosures,
  delivering strong attenuation across key frequencies while maintaining low pressure drop.
  
  [Explore RF Wave Guides][118]

# Radiation Shielding Products for Nuclear Energy, Nuclear Medicine and NDT

Since 1979, MarShield has been a North American leader in radiation shielding and lead shielding
manufacturing. As a trusted global supplier, we support industries where safety, compliance, and
performance are mandatory.

We work across [nuclear energy][92], [nuclear medicine][93], [diagnostic imaging][94],
[non-destructive testing][95], and design-build environments. Our team provides design guidance and
technical consultation to deliver **radiation shielding products** built to your exact
specifications.

### Our Shielding Materials:
* [Lead][96]
* [Lead Glass][97]
* [Lead Acrylic][98]
* [Non-lead Alternatives][99]
* [Tungsten][100]
* [Borated Polyethylene][101]
* [High Density Concrete][102]

[[We Design, Manufacture & Deliver]][103]

### MarShield holds CWB accreditation

MarShield Radiation Shielding holds CWB accreditation to [**CSA N299.3-16**][104] for the supply of
shielding solution (800) 381-5335 | [sales@marshield.com][1]

# Radiation Shielding Products for Nuclear Energy, Nuclear Medicine and NDT

Since 1979, MarShield has been a North American leader in radiation shielding and lead shielding
manufacturing. As a trusted global supplier, we support industries where safety, compliance, and
performance are mandatory.

We work across [nuclear energy][92], [nuclear medicine][93], [diagnostic imaging][94],
[non-destructive testing][95], and design-build environments. Our team provides design guidance and
technical consultation to deliver **radiation shielding products** built to your exact
specifications.

### Our Shielding Materials:
* [Lead][96]
* [Lead Glass][97]
* [Lead Acrylic][98]
* [Non-lead Alternatives][99]
* [Tungsten][100]
* [Borated Polyethylene][101]
* [High Density Concrete][102]

[[We Design, Manufacture & Deliver]][103]

### MarShield holds CWB accreditation

MarShield Radiation Shielding holds CWB accreditation to [**CSA N299.3-16**][104] for the supply of
shielding solutions to nuclear energy facilities and regulated industries across Canada and the
United States.
* ## **Let’s Start With A Quote**
  
  MarShield collaborates with your team to design custom radiation shielding built around
  performance and compliance.
  
  [Request a Quote][105]
* ## **Radiation Shielding at a Glance**
  
  See how MarShield supports medical and nuclear environments with high-integrity shielding systems.
  
  [View Our Brochure][106]

## **Radiation Shielding Products for Nuclear Medicine, Nuclear Energy, and NDT**
* ### [**Lead Lined Cabinets**][107]
  
  Custom and standard lead lined cabinets designed for secure storage and shielding in nuclear
  medicine and nuclear energy environments.
  
  [Explore Lead Lined Cabinets][108]
* ### [**L-Block Shields**][109]
  
  99.9% pure lead brick caves engineered for reliable lateral shielding in hot labs and nuclear
  medicine applications, with configurations that simplify installation.
  
  [Explore L-Bricks][110]
* ### [**Rolling Barriers**][111]
  
  Standard and custom mobile radiation barriers built with lead glass or lead acrylic viewing panels
  for dependable protection, clear visibility, and flexible use in medical and controlled
  environments.
  
  [Explore Our Rolling Barriers][112]
* ### [**Nuclear Energy Lead Pours**][113]
  
  ISO 9001:2015 and N299.3-16 certified nuclear lead pours backed by documented, industry-approved
  procedures.
  
  [Explore Nuclear Leaad Pours][114]
* ### [**Lead Bricks**][115]
  
  A full range of straight & interlocking lead bricks designed for flexible shielding configurations
  across nuclear, medical, and industrial environments.
  
  [Explore Lead Bricks][116]
* ### [**Honeycomb Wave Guides**][117]
  
  Hex cell waveguide air vents engineered to treat HVAC penetrations in RF shielded enclosures,
  delivering strong attenuation across key frequencies while maintaining low pressure drop.
  
  [Explore RF Wave Guides][118]

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

## Radiation Protection Products Made in USA

From lead shields to protective eyewear, Barrier Technologies is your one-stop-shop for all things
**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

### [Protective Aprons][31]

We offer an expansive variety of lead and lead-free aprons that can be customized to meet the unique
needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

### [Radiation Protection Gloves][32]

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

### [Radiation Protective Eyewear][33]

Our vast catalog of leaded glasses provide the highest lead content in the industry and can be
delivered in your exact prescription. In contrast to foreign-made eyewear, our lenses don’t yellow
over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

encompasses radiation shielding, criticality safety, shield integrity testing, and supporting
nuclear site licensees and other organisations with tailored solutions.

##### RADIATION
##### SHIELDING

### about us

Founded in 2016, Cerberus Nuclear brings together highly specialist skills and industry-wide
experience. We offer comprehensive Radiation Shielding, Criticality Safety and Nuclear
Characterisation services for the Civil Nuclear, Medical, Research and Defence sectors.

Our mission is to provide high quality technical solutions with an emphasis on creativity and
innovation. We achieve this by being an exemplary employer of talented individuals.
[
learn more
][19]

### product spotlight: carta

Criticality safety can be complicated; there are many physical factors that determine the
‘k-effective’ of a system (i.e. if it can become ‘critical’). Our desktop and VR software combines
physically accurate modelling and machine learning in a Virtual Reality (VR) or Desktop environment
to provide trainers with a fantastic tool to engage with all levels of trainee. It is unique from
anything else on the market as it is underpinned by accurate Monte Carlo modelling.
We offer two ready-made CARTA simulations, which will provide immediate enhancements to existing
training courses. We also offer bespoke development of training scenarios tailored to our clients
needs. We are able to model fissile systems with accuracy, both in terms of their physical behaviour
and appearance.

][20]

## [More EMI Shielding Companies][80]


### EMI Shielding Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare EMI shielding companies that manufacture products for electronics,
telecommunications, aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, industrial automation, research, and
security applications. This directory helps buyers browse suppliers of electromagnetic interference
shielding, EMI enclosures, EMI coatings, EMI filters, RF absorbers, conductive fabrics, shielding
tapes, foils, laminates, EMI gaskets, RF gasket products, RF gaskets, and RF gasketing. Source
companies by product type, shielding method, material capability, production volume, and application
experience, then connect with manufacturers that can support prototype, custom, replacement,
retrofit, or high-volume shielding requirements for sensitive equipment and controlled environments.

### EMI Enclosures and Shielded Housing Systems

EMI enclosures surround sensitive electronics with conductive barriers that reduce unwanted
electromagnetic energy entering or leaving equipment. These enclosures may be solid, vented, or
perforated depending on airflow, visibility, access, and attenuation needs. Buyers use them for
server rooms, test labs, medical devices, industrial controls, defense electronics,
telecommunications systems, and secure communication equipment where signal integrity and equipment
reliability are critical.

### EMI Coatings and EMI Filters

EMI coatings are applied to plastic housings, device shells, cable areas, and non-conductive
surfaces to create a conductive shielding layer without the weight or space requirements of a full
metal enclosure. These coatings support electronics manufacturing, automotive assemblies, consumer
devices, instrumentation, and retrofit projects where lightweight EMI shielding is needed. EMI
filters reduce conducted noise on power, data, and signal lines, making them important for power
supplies, automation equipment, medical electronics, and communication systems.

Esco Aster is a biotech factory helping to spin out our existing Tide Motion bioprocess products
and/or services with the fastest time to clinic, using our standardized, linearly scalable
biomanufacturing platforms that are globally investable and backed by an exit strategy ensuring
returns to all stakeholders — from the public, founders, foundations, and nonprofits to financial
investors.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][65]

cGMP CRDMO


cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and
dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

###### Established 1931

# Premier Building Materials Distributor

We are a wholesale building materials distributor serving lumberyards, roofing & siding
one-steppers, specialty dealers, and home centers since 1931.

[View Our Products][19] [Get In Touch][20]


## Making our customers look good since 1931.

We provide our customers with the highest quality products paired with exceptional service and
superior logistics coordination. When you choose MRS, you gain a competitive advantage in your
market, boost sales, and improve customer retention.


#### Timely Service

When you call MRS, a salesperson will greet you and provide prompt responses regarding price,
availability, and delivery date on stock items.

#### Premium Products

We align ourselves and form strategic partnerships with top-tier manufacturers in the industry to
deliver the highest quality products to our customers.  

#### Enhanced Protection

Our products are stored inside protected from harsh weather conditions. We use custom-tailored
packaging and deliver products on our fully covered side-curtain trailers.

#### Superior Logistics

We own and operate a fleet of tractors and trailers operated by experienced drivers to provide
accelerated deliveries and decreased lead times.



[About Us][21]


## Trusted by the industry’s leading brands.



## Your source for premium products.

Our carefully curated product selection ensures we bring the best quality building materials to our
markets.

## Lead Shielding for All Radioactive Applications

Lead is the only material proven to shield against all forms of ionizing radiation, making it
indispensable in radiation-shielding applications from nuclear reactors to medical X-ray labs. But
since lead is itself a toxic material, it requires the right tools, procedures, and expertise to
handle, fabricate, and transport safely.

With more than 50 years of experience crafting lead radiation shielding products for a wide variety
of applications, Nuclear Lead Co. is the preferred provider of lead radiation shielding for nuclear
power reactors, Department of Energy radiation labs, and large corporate manufacturers of
radiological equipment. Since the beginning of the atomic age, we have been in the business of
providing safety and peace of mind to people who work with dangerous materials every day.

The [custom medical lead shielding][61] fabricated by Nuclear Lead Co. makes it possible for medical
professionals and patients alike to sleep soundly at night, knowing that the device housing keeps
the radiation safely contained and pointed in the right direction. If you manufacture nuclear
medical equipment or build nuclear medical facilities, we can fabricate and customize components to
your specifications.

### Radnostix, Inc. Reports FY2026 Q1 Results - Revenue Declines 27% Primarily Due to Voluntary
### Product Recalls, Isotope Supply Disruptions, and Planned Operational Shutdown
* * Total revenue decreased 27% to $2.38 million from $3.24 million in the first quarter of 2025,
    driven by recall impacts, isotope shortages, and Co60 down time.
  * Gross profit decreased 43% to $1.15 million from $2.03 million in the prior-year period,
    reflecting recall impacts and changes in labor cost allocation.
  * Cash and cash equivalents stood at $1.35 million at quarter-end (down from $1.70 million at
    December 31, 2025), with net cash used in operating activities of $72,442.
  * Completed construction and received initial NRC license amendment for a dedicated Calibration &
    Reference Products manufacturing facility, positioning the Company for significant capacity
    expansion and product portfolio growth in 2026.
  * Completed repair and retrofit of Cobalt-60 hot cell, adding 15 to 20 years of life to the asset.
    Restarted commercial activities in Q1 2026 after more than 5 months of down time.
  * Executed mutual termination of the DUF6 asset sale agreement; Radnostix regained full control of
    these strategic assets amid the global nuclear energy boom and will evaluate development
    options, including potential license amendments for expanded uranium-related activities.

# Understanding Radiation Shielding –
# Welcome to Veritas Medical Solutions

At Veritas Medical Solutions, we understand that the primary purpose of shielding is to protect not
only patients but also staff working in or near the rooms, as well as the general public. To this
end, we have conducted significant neutron attenuation testing to ensure that our solutions meet
this important goal with 100% certainty. Guaranteed.

X-ray and gamma rays are forms of electromagnetic radiation that occur with higher energy levels
than those displayed by ultraviolet or visible light. Consequently, thick, dense shielding is
necessary to protect against the energy emitted from x-rays. Therefore, shielding and room design
are critical and consequential considerations for any healthcare facility where diagnostic and
interventional radiology are performed.

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

From lead shields to protective eyewear, Barrier Technologies is your one-stop-shop for all things
**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

### [Protective Aprons][31]

We offer an expansive variety of lead and lead-free aprons that can be customized to meet the unique
needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

### [Radiation Protection Gloves][32]

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

### [Radiation Protective Eyewear][33]

Our vast catalog of leaded glasses provide the highest lead content in the industry and can be
delivered in your exact prescription. In contrast to foreign-made eyewear, our lenses don’t yellow
over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

Characterisation services for the Civil Nuclear, Medical, Research and Defence sectors.

### product spotlight: carta

Criticality safety can be complicated; there are many physical factors that determine the
‘k-effective’ of a system (i.e. if it can become ‘critical’). Our desktop and VR software combines
physically accurate modelling and machine learning in a Virtual Reality (VR) or Desktop environment
to provide trainers with a fantastic tool to engage with all levels of trainee. It is unique from
anything else on the market as it is underpinned by accurate Monte Carlo modelling.
We offer two ready-made CARTA simulations, which will provide immediate enhancements to existing
training courses. We also offer bespoke development of training scenarios tailored to our clients
needs. We are able to model fissile systems with accuracy, both in terms of their physical behaviour
and appearance.

### product spotlight: carta

Criticality safety can be complicated; there are many physical factors that determine the
‘k-effective’ of a system (i.e. if it can become ‘critical’). Our desktop and VR software combines
physically accurate modelling and machine learning in a Virtual Reality (VR) or Desktop environment
to provide trainers with a fantastic tool to engage with all levels of trainee. It is unique from
anything else on the market as it is underpinned by accurate Monte Carlo modelling.
We offer two ready-made CARTA simulations, which will provide immediate enhancements to existing
training courses. We also offer bespoke development of training scenarios tailored to our clients
needs. We are able to model fissile systems with accuracy, both in terms of their physical behaviour
and appearance.

### EMI Shielding Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare EMI shielding companies that manufacture products for electronics,
telecommunications, aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, industrial automation, research, and
security applications. This directory helps buyers browse suppliers of electromagnetic interference
shielding, EMI enclosures, EMI coatings, EMI filters, RF absorbers, conductive fabrics, shielding
tapes, foils, laminates, EMI gaskets, RF gasket products, RF gaskets, and RF gasketing. Source
companies by product type, shielding method, material capability, production volume, and application
experience, then connect with manufacturers that can support prototype, custom, replacement,
retrofit, or high-volume shielding requirements for sensitive equipment and controlled environments.

### EMI Enclosures and Shielded Housing Systems

EMI enclosures surround sensitive electronics with conductive barriers that reduce unwanted
electromagnetic energy entering or leaving equipment. These enclosures may be solid, vented, or
perforated depending on airflow, visibility, access, and attenuation needs. Buyers use them for
server rooms, test labs, medical devices, industrial controls, defense electronics,
telecommunications systems, and secure communication equipment where signal integrity and equipment
reliability are critical.

### EMI Coatings and EMI Filters

EMI coatings are applied to plastic housings, device shells, cable areas, and non-conductive
surfaces to create a conductive shielding layer without the weight or space requirements of a full
metal enclosure. These coatings support electronics manufacturing, automotive assemblies, consumer
devices, instrumentation, and retrofit projects where lightweight EMI shielding is needed. EMI
filters reduce conducted noise on power, data, and signal lines, making them important for power
supplies, automation equipment, medical electronics, and communication systems.

cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and
dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

### The Kennedy Vinyl

Kennedy Vinyl was founded in 1976 with the objective of becoming the leading manufacturer of mass
loaded acoustic vinyl barriers. Our factory is located in Scottsboro, Alabama which spans 7 acres
and boasts over 25,000 square feet of production space.

A couple of decades later, we started manufacturing X-Ray protective vinyl materials, cementing our
position as a producer of ultrafine particles of very high purity that guarantees top-grade quality

standards throughout the manufacturing process and beyond. We comply as per the Quality Management
System – ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016.

Building on our legacy of innovation, Kennedy has since evolved into a distinguished American brand

## About Us

Lambert Radiation Shielding has been working together with Medical Health Professionals, Architects
and Diagnostic Imaging Equipment Manufacturers since 1948. 

Lambert Radiation Shielding Ltd. understands that there are many related health risks that coincide
with dealing with radiation. 
* We have installed over 8 million pounds of lead since our inception and our credibility and
  construction knowledge in radiation protection is matched by no one. 
* We are able to anticipate flaws to designs prior to construction, saving our clients enormous
  amounts, while working alongside the biggest contractors in North America like PCL, EllisDon and
  Stuart Olson Dominion.
* We have no limit to what we can shield. LINAC vaults, cyclotrons, medical and dental x-ray suites,
  Nuclear/RF and MRI shielding projects are among the long list of our specialties. 

The most important objective is that when LRS completes a project, our radiation shielding
installation is complete to the site specific Qualified Radiation Experts attenuation levels,
ensuring the safety of all. 



This provides, the Owner, the comfort that all has been done to satisfy the Radiation Protection
Act, alleviating any staff poisoning that would most likely have occurred if the shielding had been
installed with unskilled contractors, stopping any litigation that would follow.  

## Our Services
* PET CT Scanner
* Medical Diagnostic Imaging X-ray suites
* Dental X-ray suites
* X-ray Shielding Lead Glass
* Lead lined Doors

* Lead Vaults and Containers
* Demountable Radiation Shielding Enclosures
* Portable Shielding Barriers
* MRI enclosures

* Ionizing Radiation Protection

* Borated polyethylene
* Brachytherapy enclosures

###### Established 1931

# Premier Building Materials Distributor

We are a wholesale building materials distributor serving lumberyards, roofing & siding
one-steppers, specialty dealers, and home centers since 1931.

[View Our Products][19] [Get In Touch][20]


## Making our customers look good since 1931.

We provide our customers with the highest quality products paired with exceptional service and
superior logistics coordination. When you choose MRS, you gain a competitive advantage in your
market, boost sales, and improve customer retention.


#### Timely Service

When you call MRS, a salesperson will greet you and provide prompt responses regarding price,
availability, and delivery date on stock items.

#### Premium Products

We align ourselves and form strategic partnerships with top-tier manufacturers in the industry to
deliver the highest quality products to our customers.  

#### Enhanced Protection

Our products are stored inside protected from harsh weather conditions. We use custom-tailored
packaging and deliver products on our fully covered side-curtain trailers.

#### Superior Logistics

We own and operate a fleet of tractors and trailers operated by experienced drivers to provide
accelerated deliveries and decreased lead times.



[About Us][21]


## Trusted by the industry’s leading brands.



## Your source for premium products.

Our carefully curated product selection ensures we bring the best quality building materials to our
markets.

materials available.

Whether you’re quoting a siding job or helping your customer design their outdoor dream space, MRS
is here to help! With our practical toolbox, you can be sure to provide your customers with the
information and support they need throughout every step of the process.

## What are you **looking for?**

We design and supply shielding solutions for medical, energy, research, and security applications.

## Lead Shielding for All Radioactive Applications

Lead is the only material proven to shield against all forms of ionizing radiation, making it
indispensable in radiation-shielding applications from nuclear reactors to medical X-ray labs. But
since lead is itself a toxic material, it requires the right tools, procedures, and expertise to
handle, fabricate, and transport safely.

With more than 50 years of experience crafting lead radiation shielding products for a wide variety
of applications, Nuclear Lead Co. is the preferred provider of lead radiation shielding for nuclear
power reactors, Department of Energy radiation labs, and large corporate manufacturers of
radiological equipment. Since the beginning of the atomic age, we have been in the business of
providing safety and peace of mind to people who work with dangerous materials every day.

[Custom medical lead shielding by Nuclear Lead Co.]

life-saving miracle of X-rays, magnetic resonance imaging, or radiation therapy. Even the
technicians and medical professionals who work with these advanced technologies every day often
don’t give a second thought to the potential danger posed by nuclear medical devices.

The [custom medical lead shielding][61] fabricated by Nuclear Lead Co. makes it possible for medical
professionals and patients alike to sleep soundly at night, knowing that the device housing keeps
the radiation safely contained and pointed in the right direction. If you manufacture nuclear
medical equipment or build nuclear medical facilities, we can fabricate and customize components to
your specifications.

[Call Us Now!][62]

### Product Recalls, Isotope Supply Disruptions, and Planned Operational Shutdown

    expansion and product portfolio growth in 2026.

    Restarted commercial activities in Q1 2026 after more than 5 months of down time.

Every lead apron radiology inspection is fully X-rayed to detect holes, cracks, and hidden defects -
the only way to catch damage you can't see or feel. TJC-compliant reports generated same day.

[][20]

Every apron gets a unique Barcode and is logged into the ShieldRenu app. Track departments,
inspection dates, cleaning history, and export audit-ready reports instantly.

84% of lead aprons test positive for Staph and Ringworm. Each apron is sprayed and wiped with a

# Understanding Radiation Shielding –
# Welcome to Veritas Medical Solutions

At Veritas Medical Solutions, we understand that the primary purpose of shielding is to protect not
only patients but also staff working in or near the rooms, as well as the general public. To this
end, we have conducted significant neutron attenuation testing to ensure that our solutions meet
this important goal with 100% certainty. Guaranteed.

X-ray and gamma rays are forms of electromagnetic radiation that occur with higher energy levels
than those displayed by ultraviolet or visible light. Consequently, thick, dense shielding is
necessary to protect against the energy emitted from x-rays. Therefore, shielding and room design
are critical and consequential considerations for any healthcare facility where diagnostic and
interventional radiology are performed.

# Understanding Radiation Shielding –
# Welcome to Veritas Medical Solutions

At Veritas Medical Solutions, we understand that the primary purpose of shielding is to protect not
only patients but also staff working in or near the rooms, as well as the general public. To this
end, we have conducted significant neutron attenuation testing to ensure that our solutions meet
this important goal with 100% certainty. Guaranteed.

X-ray and gamma rays are forms of electromagnetic radiation that occur with higher energy levels
than those displayed by ultraviolet or visible light. Consequently, thick, dense shielding is
necessary to protect against the energy emitted from x-rays. Therefore, shielding and room design
are critical and consequential considerations for any healthcare facility where diagnostic and
interventional radiology are performed.
